basic_details.job_title: District Court, Pathanamthitta Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Office Attendant, Confidential Assistant and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The District Court (Jilla Kodathi), Pathanamthitta has invited applications for 4 contract posts in the Special Fast Track Court, Adoor: Confidential Assistant (1), Computer Assistant/LD Typist (1) and Office Attendant (2). Only people who retired from the same or higher posts in the Kerala Judicial Department can apply. Applications can be handed in at the District Court office, Pathanamthitta, or sent by post, and they must reach the office on or before 6 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About Pathanamthitta District Court
content_sections.text: The District Court, Pathanamthitta is the district court for Pathanamthitta district in Kerala. These posts are in the Special Fast Track Court, Adoor, which was sanctioned in Pathanamthitta district to dispose of cases registered under the POCSO Act. The recruitment follows the High Court of Kerala's directions in OM.No.D7A(1)-56450/2018/D7(B)/DII-3 dated 8 April 2022 and 3 June 2022, and the Government of Kerala orders GO(Ms)No.20/2022/HOME dated 4 February 2022 and GO(Ms) No.105/2022/HOME dated 28 May 2022.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Write your application on white paper and paste your own photograph on it. Attach documents that prove your age, qualification and identity. You can hand the application in at the District Court office, Pathanamthitta, or send it by post. It must reach the District Court office on or before 6 November 2026. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The 4 vacancies are being filled from a panel. The panel is being prepared for contract appointment in the Special Fast Track Court, Adoor. The same eligibility rules apply to all three posts: Who can apply: Appointment is only for people who retired from the same posts, or from higher posts, in the Kerala Judicial Department. Educational qualification: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. It invites applications from people with the required qualification, and applicants must attach proof of their qualification. Age limit: You must not have completed 62 years. An appointee will be relieved on completing 62 years. Nature of appointment: The contract runs for a continuous period of 179 days only. See the official notification for the eligibility conditions of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Pathanamthitta District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 1 Confidential Assistant, 1 Computer Assistant/LD Typist and 2 Office Attendant posts, all in the Special Fast Track Court, Adoor.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for Pathanamthitta District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the District Court office, Pathanamthitta on or before 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for these Pathanamthitta District Court posts?
faq.answer: Only people who retired from the same posts, or from higher posts, in the Kerala Judicial Department can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Applicants must not have completed 62 years. An appointee will be relieved on completing 62 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly pay is Rs. 24,590/- for Confidential Assistant, Rs. 23,360/- for Computer Assistant/LD Typist and Rs. 20,280/- for Office Attendant.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for Pathanamthitta District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Write your application on white paper, paste your own photograph on it and attach proof of age, qualification and identity. Then hand it in at the District Court office, Pathanamthitta, or send it by post so that it arrives by 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job, and for how long is the contract?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on contract, for a continuous period of 179 days only. The selected person must sign a contract agreement in the prescribed format in front of the District Judge.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the selected candidates work?
faq.answer: The posts are in the Special Fast Track Court, Adoor. This court was sanctioned in Pathanamthitta district to dispose of cases registered under the POCSO Act.
